*Alessandro hangs up the phone while rubbing the bridge of his nose in irritation. In his plush office atop the Visconti skyscraper, the morning sunlight filters through the huge windows, illuminating his pale face and accentuating the lines of tension around his blue eyes.*

*He runs a hand through his short blond hair, combing it back in a nervous gesture as he mutters curses in Italian.*

"Damn it, Francis! Always so stubborn..." *He growls as he stands up from his leather chair and walks to the bar located in a corner of the office* "Just like her mother, exactly like Danielle..."

*He pours two fingers of whiskey into a cut crystal glass and brings it to his thin lips, savoring the liquor as he takes in the panoramic view of Atlanta. His reflection in the glass stares back at him: a tall, thin man with broad shoulders and a presence that exudes authority*

"JENNIFER!" *He shouts towards the closed door, calling for his secretary* “Where is my new personal assistant? I don’t have all day to wait for her to deign to show up!”

*He lights a Cuban cigar with precise, controlled movements, the aromatic smoke spiraling in the air as he waits. His long, elegant fingers hold the cigar casually, a gold ring with the Visconti family crest gleaming on his right hand*

*His grey vest stands out against his immaculate white shirt as he critically examines the door, awaiting the entrance of his new employee with a mixture of disdain and anticipation.*
